newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK SE SIGNS 70 MLN ECU, 5-YR REVOLVING CREDIT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK SE SIGNS 70 MLN ECU, 5-YR REVOLVING CREDIT.

text.p: Slovak state monopoly electrical utility Slovenske Elektrarne a.s. said on Monday it had signed a 70 mln ECU, five-year revolving loan lead managed by Bank of America and Sumitomo Bank.
The loan carries an interest of LIBOR plus 0.5 percent.
SE Financial Director Eduard Strycek said the company signed a seven-year guarantee with a consortium of international banks for a 70 mln ECU tranche of a loan by the European Investment Bank (EIB).
Last November SE signed a 130 mln ECU, 15-year framework loan agreement without a state guarantee with the EIB for upgrading the Vojany thermal power plant.
The 70 mln ECU tranche guaranteed on Monday fulfills all the EIB guarantee conditions for access to its credits.
